title: Duplicate Frames Toggle Tutorial
whatItIs: Step 05 of a toggle tutorial: a glowing number bubble, italic heading, instruction and two side-by-side frames showing the toggle in Dark and Light states, with the link bar below.
whatItMeans: Showing both states side by side communicates the end result of the copy-and-edit step at a glance.
techniques: Two frames displaying before and after states
Tonal grey palette so the toggle is the hero
Small caption text inside frames for realism
Light frame lifted slightly for contrast

vocabulary.definition: Two frames showing a component in different states.
A switch control moving between two options.
A sequence of numbered posts with identical layout.
